label: Medusa A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back in row-major order
description: The exact native adult female Medusa archer: slender humanoid upper body and a long thick dark olive-green snake tail, coiled on the ground, pale blue-lavender segmented belly scutes, dark diamond-pattern scales and a narrow horn-colored pointed rattling tail tip. Small stern blue-gray face with pale highlights, narrow eyes and no glow. Numerous separate long slender black-green and ochre-gold snakes hang from the crown around shoulders; preserve native individual curves, tiny snake heads and gold-brown bands. Polished dark silver breastplate covers the chest, gold edging and small red-gold waist band; back leather straps support the tall dark brown quiver full of gold-brown arrows. Slim pale green-gray arms with gold upper-arm bands and dark wrist cuffs. Left hand holds one slender black recurved bow with gold fittings and taut fine string; right hand follows each native empty hand, arrow-reaching or shooting pose. Preserve the exact native bow length, curve and orientation, quiver angle, tail coils, slender torso and small head. No human legs or feet, no added snake heads, oversized crown, wings, magic glow, blood, environment or redesign. Keep the native dark tonal weight and silver armor in every cell.

materials.limitation: Enhanced silver metal defines coverage within native armor support; gold trim and colored highlights are partly protected and do not exactly reproduce indexed recoloring.
